purpose: Teach: 泙/蹐/癲/腓/磴/曚/儖/蕁

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、古典詩の水音、つまり泙の擬音研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the onomatopoeia of water sounds in classical poetry, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Gentle confirmation phrased as a question. Steady pace, professional but genuinely interested. Leans slightly forward.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、跼蹐、つまり蹐の語源と過度な遠慮の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the etymology of hesitation and how it appears in classical texts.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Direct eye contact. Measured pace—not rushed, not performed. A slight lift at the end as if offering the answer for genuine consideration.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 癲癇、つまり癲発作の歴史的記録の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the historical records of convulsions in your research, I believe.
lines.style: Thoughtful, inviting. Gentle confirmation—not testing, but walking through the work together. Slight pause before speaking, as if recalling something important.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、下腿の腓腹筋、つまり腓の運動学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined the kinesiology of the calf muscle and how it functions in movement.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Speaking from the center of her knowledge. No apology in the tone. Clear articulation, even pace throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 登山道の磴、つまり石段の地理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered the geography of stone steps and mountain paths, if I'm remembering correctly.
lines.style: Curious, warm. Phrased as a gentle question—inviting her to confirm. Unhurried. The voice of someone who actually listens to her students.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、曚気、つまり曚の薄暗さの古典詩研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched how dimness appears in classical poetry and what it symbolized to ancient writers.
lines.style: Composed, present. Grounded in the material. No hesitation. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who has thought this through deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古代の儖、つまり儖の人体表記の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you also examined ancient texts on the human form and how the body was described in old records.
lines.style: Acknowledging, attentive. A soft moment of connection—she's genuinely impressed. Slight warmth in the delivery. Pace is deliberate, almost meditative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、蕁麻疹、つまり蕁の皮膚反応の臨床研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper covered a clinical study of skin reactions and how they were documented in medical literature.
lines.style: Final answer with quiet pride. Steady, clear delivery. A slight breath-ease at the end—the relief of completing something real. Grounded, not performative.
